channel.title: Steam Deals Tracker
channel.description: Temporarily free and newly added Steam deals.

item.title: Lootbound
item.description: Lootbound is a tactical roguelite with turn-based combat, loot management and D&D elements set in a dark fantasy world. Fight dangerous enemies, collect epic loot, recruit allies and lead them on a path of adventure.

item.title: Rogue Eclipse
item.description: Spaceflight action for the new age! Push your piloting skills to the ultimate test, blast and burn your way through swarms of starfighters, merciless armadas and colossal behemoths in an epic roguelike campaign that spans the cosmos. Easy to learn, tricky to master, and impossible to put down.

item.title: Tidy Up Together
item.description: Catastrophe! An evil wizard has cast a tornado spell on your shop, and now all your products are on the floor. Maybe you'll ask some friends for help to tidy up?

item.title: TV Archive: Tidy Up Together
item.description: Shelve the videotapes, unlock new skills, and use your unique methods to tidy up the TV archive. Enjoy the online co-op and online PvP with your friends, or go solo! Fill up the shelves and experience a sense of relief and satisfaction.

item.title: 不心动才有鬼
item.description: With sudden powers, meet 6 unique girls in an extraordinary campus romance. Campus beauty, teacher, maiden, or girl next door... sweet or dangerous, all have secrets. Don't Blush is a 1st-person FMV romance where your choices shape everyone's fate. Beyond boundaries, beyond mere sparks.

item.title: 30XX
item.description: Jump, shoot, and slash your way through 30XX, the roguelike action platformer you can play with a friend! Explore lush, ever-changing worlds that mix precise platforming with fevered combat. Destroy fearsome Guardians. Master unique Powers. Rediscover the thousand years we've lost.

item.title: Evil School
item.description: This game is an FMV about anti-bullying. A teenage girl mysteriously disappeared, and the truth was buried by power for eight years. Now, you return to this place of evil with a bloodstained list. The moment of slay & judgment has arrived...

item.title: Prison Escape Simulator: Dig Out
item.description: Too long in this prison, time to get out of here. Pull the carpet and start digging with a teaspoon. Watch out for the guard, sell him the junk you find. Trade toilet paper with the prisoners. Get better items and improve your stats. Expand the tunnel, use glow sticks and dynamite. Will you escape?

item.title: Baldur's Gate II: Enhanced Edition
item.description: Return to a timeless RPG masterpiece. Baldur’s Gate II: Enhanced Edition brings the classic 2000 adventure back to life with thoughtful modern refinements, letting you gather your party and dive once more into a rich, choice‑driven fantasy epic.

item.title: Bang Bang Barrage
item.description: Survive the treacherous sea in this quirky multiplayer shooter game! Play solo or team up and fight off Cthulhu's minions. Master a unique recoil-based mechanic to blast enemies and chart your course. Mix and match upgrades to craft the perfect sea-surviving strategy!

item.title: Bum Simulator
item.description: Bum Simulator is a sandbox game bursting with inappropriate humor and memorable characters. You live on the streets of Bumsville. Do you have what it takes to adapt, survive and become an urban legend?

item.title: Crusader Kings III: Khans of the Steppe
item.description: In Khans of the Steppe, only the strongest will survive the harsh realities of life on the Steppe. Will you rise to greatness, carving a legacy of conquest, or will your people vanish into the annals of history? The choice is yours.

item.title: Crusader Kings III: Royal Court
item.description: The Royal Court expansion to Crusader Kings III adds new ways to interact with the characters in your kingdom or empire, as well as major changes to the cultural system of the game, adding greater dynamism and historical fluidity.

item.title: Duel Corp.
item.description: A Souls-inspired action RPG set in a sandbox open world with an MMO feel and challenging directional combat. Play solo or with up to 3 friends in co-op. Build friendships, master an unrestricted class system, and uncover the cause that darkened all eyes.

item.title: Icewind Dale: Enhanced Edition
item.description: The frozen classic returns. Icewind Dale: Enhanced Edition preserves the spirit of the original adventure while refining it for modern players, letting you build a party of Dungeons & Dragons heroes and brave the harsh, haunting beauty of the Spine of the World.

item.title: Mr. Prepper
item.description: Mr. Prepper is about being prepared. You know something is wrong. The risk of a nuclear war is in the air and you need to get ready for what's coming.

item.title: Neverwinter Nights: Enhanced Edition
item.description: Return to the Forgotten Realms in this bestselling Dungeons & Dragons roleplaying game. Combines all the content of Neverwinter Nights Diamond Edition with all-new enhanced features. Includes 100+ hours of award-winning adventures and the tools to create your own!

item.title: Planescape: Torment: Enhanced Edition
item.description: Uncover secrets of past lives in this story-rich, tactical roleplaying game set in Sigil, a dark fantasy city at the heart of the Dungeons & Dragons multiverse. Explore the planes, survive combat alongside a party of bizarre companions, and solve puzzles unlike any ever seen in the genre.

item.title: Tank Mechanic Simulator
item.description: Renovate & build II World War tanks. Experience highly detailed & realistic simulation game. Take tanks fully apart by using different tools. Transform them from rusty and ruined to fully working. Check them on the training ground, sell or put into your own museum.

item.title: The Lamplighters League
item.description: Recruit a team of misfits with unique abilities and unforgettable personalities, and chase the Banished Court to the ends of the earth in a mix of real-time infiltration, turn-based tactical combat, and a character-driven story of adventure and intrigue.

item.title: Baldur's Gate: Enhanced Edition
item.description: The classic returns! Baldur’s Gate: Enhanced Edition restores the full original adventure and Tales of the Sword Coast, now polished with quality‑of‑life upgrades for a smoother timeless Dungeons & Dragons journey.

item.title: Clawed
item.description: Embark on a covert mission to the dinosaur theme park Prehistoria, where you must explore the park's grounds to scavenge resources, solve puzzles, and fight your way through diverse biomes, underground tunnels and deadly enclosures. But beware, you are not the apex predator here.

item.title: Creepshow
item.description: Get lost in a deliciously dark horror anthology. Inspired by Shudder’s Creepshow series, this point-and-click adventure has gone all kinds of wrong.

item.title: Crusader Kings III: All Under Heaven
item.description: With All Under Heaven, the vast and dynamic history of Asia comes to life. Claim the Mandate, unite your people, and shape the future of empires in this monumental expansion for Crusader Kings III.

item.title: Crusader Kings III: Roads to Power
item.description: The glory and might of the Byzantine Empire is yours to command in 'Roads to Power' the new Major expansion to Crusader Kings III. Explore the Empire's unique politics, cultures and governing systems, climb the societal ladder, or seek fame and glory a landless Adventurer.

item.title: Crusader Kings III: Tours & Tournaments
item.description: Life is a journey of chivalric adventure, so why don’t you embrace yours, ruler? Create your very own epic story with the major expansion, Crusader Kings III: Tours & Tournaments.

item.title: Cult of the Lamb: Cultist Pack
item.description: Be the envy of every cult with this exclusive Cultist Pack that includes a seven-piece decoration pack for your charming commune, as well as five exclusive Follower forms.

item.title: Cultist Simulator
item.description: Seize forbidden treasures. Summon alien gods. Feed on your disciples. Cultist Simulator is a game of apocalypse and yearning. Play as a seeker after unholy mysteries, in a 1920s-themed setting of hidden gods and secret histories.

item.title: Dagger Directive
item.description: Dagger Directive is a tactical FPS that allows you to approach each mission in your own way. Select equipment, decide the time of day, then move methodically to complete your mission. Enjoy the modern mechanics and old school graphics as you fight across a variety of missions and environments.

item.title: Defender of the Crown: The Legend Returns
item.description: The legendary medieval strategy adventure has returned – enhanced for a new generation of knights. Conquer provinces, raise armies, storm castles, and influence the balance of power through bold strategy and action moments.

item.title: Demon Slayer -Kimetsu no Yaiba- The Hinokami Chronicles 2
item.description: Destroy demons with the power of forged bonds! Tanjiro Kamado's battle will once again unfold…

item.title: Deponia
item.description: In Deponia, the world has degenerated into a vast garbage dump, in which the crotchety Rufus ekes out his sorry existence.

item.title: Dicey Dungeons
item.description: Become a giant walking dice, explore dungeons and defy Lady Luck in this dice powered roguelike! Now featuring "Reunion", a free DLC with six brand-new episodes!

item.title: Flock of the Seraphim
item.description: Exorcise hordes of demons using gun-wielding nuns and angels in this survivors-like bullet heaven! Collect and keep angels with unique weapons, stats, and abilities to create god-like builds as you fend off waves of enemies! Do you have enough faith to survive?

item.title: Future Knight
item.description: Frenetic action and LCD aesthetic! In this 2D Shoot 'Em Up, switch between a robot hero and his benign tumor to stop a bizarre cult. You have 8 hours to save humanity's memory: defeat grotesque bosses, ride the skies on your Future Board, and master the chaos in a retro-futuristic Tokyo.

item.title: Ledgerbound
item.description: Deny an insurance claim, save the world. Ledgerbound is a hilarious, narrative-driven tactical RPG/dating sim filled with all your favorite epic fantasy activities: battling evil enemies, filling out paperwork, rescuing your company from financial ruin, pursuing HR-approved relationships, and more!

item.title: Ledgerbound - Deluxe Supporter Edition
item.description: Ledgerbound's Deluxe Supporter Edition is the second-best way to support the narrative-driven tactical RPG Ledgerbound. This upgrade unlocks luxurious cosmetic rewards and our digital soundtrack.

item.title: Low-Budget Repairs
item.description: Manage renovations in 90s apartment blocks! Focus on quick profit and cut costs wherever possible. Client notices defects? Tough luck, the money's already in your pocket. Every day brings new challenges and decisions that can lead to fortune... or trouble!

item.title: Memoirium
item.description: Traverse a chaotic and crumbling realm of dreams composed of liminal spaces. Adapt to the world’s odd rules as a Dreamer, and defy others like you to escape the strange and eclectic subconscious landscape.

item.title: Rusty Lake: Roots
item.description: Experience the beginning and end of characters' lives and build your own family tree! Rusty Lake: Roots is the second premium point-and-click adventure by the creators of the Cube Escape series and Rusty Lake Hotel.

item.title: Sandustry
item.description: Explore and mine fully destructible worlds. Automate increasingly complex production chains. Delve deep to uncover an ancient civilization’s powerful secrets and learn to love the sand in this factory game where every pixel is a valuable resource.

item.title: Ship Graveyard Simulator 2
item.description: Dust off your torch and hammer - it's time to get back to work, you have a new job to do. Visit the new beach coast with the largest, biggest ship graveyard in the world, dismantle huge ship parts and collect tons of precious steel. Roll up your sleeves, it's time to get back to the business.

item.title: SimRail - The Railway Simulator
item.description: SimRail is new, advanced railway simulator. Master high-speed long-distance EMU, heavy freight hauls and suburban trains. Travel 500 km of geodetic-data based real routes. Become train dispatcher and control the traffic according to the schedule or cooperate with other players on multiplayer mode.

item.title: SimRail - The Railway Simulator: Łódź North Region
item.description: Take the controls or the dispatcher's panel across 140 km of single-track lines from Kutno through Łęczyca to Zgierz and Łowicz. Drive freight, passenger and express trains to the timetable and manage passing loops in the Łódź North Region DLC for SimRail - The Railway Simulator.

item.title: Sort Them Ducks
item.description: Sort Them Ducks is a cozy organizing simulator where you sort over 4,000 unique rubber ducks onto the correct shelves. Enjoy the satisfying process of turning a messy duck store into a perfectly organized collection at your own pace.

item.title: The Past Within
item.description: The Past Within is the new co-op experience from Rusty Lake! Play together with someone you deem trustworthy: one in The Past, the other in The Future. Observe and communicate what you see around you. Solve the puzzles and uncover Albert Vanderboom’s plan.

item.title: Wild West Miner Simulator
item.description: You've become the major of a town that... doesn't exist. Nobody lives here, the governor's stupid joke. It's time to get to work and turn this NOWHERE into a bustling metropolis. Mine coal, ore, and gold. Build houses, find oil, bring in new residents, create a paradise in the middle of nowhere.

item.title: ZERO Sievert
item.description: Now with over 600,000 copies sold, ZERO Sievert is a tense top-down extraction shooter that challenges you to scavenge a procedurally-generated wasteland, loot gear, and explore what’s left of a devastated world. When the odds are stacked against you, you’ll need to do more than just survive...

item.title: Duskfade
item.description: Shatter the shackles of time as you jump, swing, and slash through a fantastic world in this love letter to classic 3D action platformers. Zirian, accompanied by his mechanical Cuckoo, must save his sister from a mysterious Clock Tower that has plunged the land into eternal night.

item.title: Emergency Room Simulator
item.description: In Emergency Room Simulator, step into the role of an ER doctor: run targeted tests, treat patients, and save lives when it matters most. Experience intense shifts in a fast-paced medical environment.

item.title: Servant of the Lake
item.description: Begin your new job as a servant at the mysterious Vanderboom estate. Solve puzzles, serve the family and uncover their dark alchemical secrets in Servant of the Lake, a new upcoming single-player point-and-click adventure in the Rusty Lake series.

item.title: VanySlash
item.description: Heroine, a close-combat magic-user, and her partner, an axe to fight and collect magical Tools!
